# Clerk Billing: subscriptions, plans and plan gating

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @clerk's official guide for Clerk Billing subscription management: rendering the PricingTable component and the in-app checkout drawer, configuring subscription plans and seat-limit B2B plans, gating features with `has({ plan })` / `has({ feature })`, programmatic billing config via the CLI, and handling billing webhooks (with the important note that Clerk webhook event names differ from Stripe's). Honest caveats: **no license declared in the repository — license unknown**, so this is a short fiche linking to the source, without reusing its content; requires a Clerk account with Billing enabled — the free tier covers development through the shared Clerk development gateway; production payment processing needs a Stripe account; the Billing APIs are still experimental. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
